name: PD1180-EPR — NEMA 34 Smart Motor-Mounted Stepper Controller with USB-C PD 3.1 EPR

usb_ports.J1: Dedicated 48 V / 5 A USB-C PD 3.1 EPR POWER sink; no USB data
usb_ports.J10: USB 2.0 DATA plus independent, current-limited logic power; two 5.1k CC Rd; no PD negotiation and no connection to VMOTOR

mechanical.outline: TMCM-1180 V1.1 stepped perimeter with four 5.9 mm concave corner arcs

encoder.validation: Magnet orientation and working gap require mechanical and powered validation after changing assembly side.

fabrication.via_in_pad: filled and capped for CSD19534 thermal pads

connectors.J7: 20-pin keyed JST PHD industrial harness; all former J6/J7/J9 functions retained

industrial_harness.warning: Pin 17 is protected VMOTOR (~48 V), not a 24 V auxiliary output. New harness is not pin-compatible with previous separate connectors.
industrial_harness.current_rating: 3 A/contact with AWG22 per JST; system output current remains limited by the original output circuitry.

logic_power.motor_power: J1 only; USB DATA cannot energize VMOTOR
logic_power.reverse_blocking: Two cascaded status-interlocked LM66100 pairs; DATA and PD VBUS are never connected
logic_power.usb_default_budget: Startup before enumeration and USB suspend current must be measured and qualified; the current limiter is overload protection, not a USB enumeration policy
logic_power.usb_data_power: USB DATA alone powers setup/diagnostics. Firmware advertises bus-powered, 500 mA configuration. VMOTOR remains PD-only.
logic_power.U25: USB_DATA_VBUS -> TPS2553 U28 -> TLV75533 U25 -> V3V3_USB
logic_power.selection: U26/U27 + R112: status-interlocked LM66100 OR of V3V3_BOARD and V3V3_USB into V3V3

temperature.validation: Board temperature only; MOSFET junction correlation and thresholds require load testing

phase_current.validation: Instantaneous diagnostics; nominal VDDA and offset require calibration. Not a short-circuit trip or an RMS estimate.
